   "source": [
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "\n",
    "from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split\n",
    "from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder, StandardScaler\n",
    "from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer\n",
    "from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline\n",
    "from sklearn.ensemble import HistGradientBoostingRegressor\n",
    "from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, classification_report, confusion_matrix\n",
    "\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "# 1. Prepare data\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "df_reg = pd.read_csv(\"global_ai_jobs.csv\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Remove leakage columns\n",
    "drop_cols = ['bonus_usd', 'salary_percentile', 'id']\n",
    "df_reg = df_reg.drop(columns=[c for c in drop_cols if c in df_reg.columns])\n",
    "\n",
    "df_reg = df_reg.dropna()\n",
    "\n",
    "NUM_BINS = 3\n",
    "\n",
    "# Create true 5 salary bins and save bin edges\n",
    "df_reg['salary_bin_5'], bin_edges = pd.qcut(\n",
    "    df_reg['salary_usd'],\n",
    "    q=NUM_BINS,\n",
    "    labels=False,\n",
    "    retbins=True,\n",
    "    duplicates='drop'\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "df_reg['salary_bin_5'] = df_reg['salary_bin_5'].astype(int)\n",
    "\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "# 2. Features and targets\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "X = df_reg.drop(columns=['salary_usd', 'salary_bin_5'])\n",
    "y_salary = df_reg['salary_usd']\n",
    "y_bin = df_reg['salary_bin_5']\n",
    "\n",
    "cat_cols = X.select_dtypes(exclude=np.number).columns.tolist()\n",
    "num_cols = X.select_dtypes(include=np.number).columns.tolist()\n",
    "\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "# 3. Train-test split\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "X_train, X_test, y_salary_train, y_salary_test, y_bin_train, y_bin_test = train_test_split(\n",
    "    X,\n",
    "    y_salary,\n",
    "    y_bin,\n",
    "    test_size=0.30,\n",
    "    random_state=42,\n",
    "    stratify=y_bin\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "# 4. Preprocessing\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "preprocess = ColumnTransformer([\n",
    "    ('cat', OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore'), cat_cols),\n",
    "    ('num', StandardScaler(with_mean=False), num_cols)\n",
    "])\n",
    "\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "# 5. Regression model\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "reg_model = Pipeline([\n",
    "    ('preprocess', preprocess),\n",
    "    ('regressor', HistGradientBoostingRegressor(\n",
    "        max_iter=700,\n",
    "        learning_rate=0.035,\n",
    "        max_leaf_nodes=63,\n",
    "        min_samples_leaf=35,\n",
    "        l2_regularization=0.05,\n",
    "        random_state=42\n",
    "    ))\n",
    "])\n",
    "\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "# 6. Train\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "reg_model.fit(X_train, y_salary_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "# 7. Predict salary, then convert to bins\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "pred_salary = reg_model.predict(X_test)\n",
    "\n",
    "pred_bins = np.digitize(pred_salary, bin_edges[1:-1], right=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "# keep values safely inside 0 to NUM_BINS-1\n",
    "pred_bins = np.clip(pred_bins, 0, NUM_BINS - 1)\n",
    "\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "# 8. Evaluate\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "print(\"Regression → 5-bin accuracy:\", accuracy_score(y_bin_test, pred_bins))\n",
    "print(\"\\nClassification Report:\")\n",
    "print(classification_report(y_bin_test, pred_bins))\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\nConfusion Matrix:\")\n",
    "print(confusion_matrix(y_bin_test, pred_bins))\n",
    "\n",
    "errors = np.abs(y_bin_test.values - pred_bins)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\nExact accuracy:\", np.mean(errors == 0))\n",
    "print(\"Within 1 bin accuracy:\", np.mean(errors <= 1))\n",
    "print(\"Mean bin error:\", np.mean(errors))"
   ]
  },

    "from sklearn.model_selection import RandomizedSearchCV\n",
    "from sklearn.ensemble import HistGradientBoostingClassifier\n",
    "from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline\n",
    "from scipy.stats import randint, uniform\n",
    "from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, classification_report\n",
    "\n",
    "pipe = Pipeline([\n",
    "    ('preprocess', preprocess),\n",
    "    ('classifier', HistGradientBoostingClassifier(random_state=42))\n",
    "])\n",
    "\n",
    "param_dist = {\n",
    "    'classifier__max_iter': randint(300, 1200),\n",
    "    'classifier__learning_rate': uniform(0.01, 0.08),\n",

    "    'classifier__max_bins': randint(64, 255)\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "search = RandomizedSearchCV(\n",
    "    pipe,\n",
    "    param_distributions=param_dist,\n",
    "    n_iter=40,\n",
    "    scoring='accuracy',\n",
    "    cv=3,\n",
    "    verbose=2,\n",
    "    random_state=42,\n",
    "    n_jobs=-1\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "search.fit(X_train, y_bin_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Best CV Accuracy:\", search.best_score_)\n",
    "print(\"Best Params:\")\n",
    "print(search.best_params_)\n",
    "\n",
    "best_model = search.best_estimator_\n",
    "\n",
    "pred = best_model.predict(X_test)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Test Accuracy:\", accuracy_score(y_bin_test, pred))\n",
    "print(classification_report(y_bin_test, pred))"
   ]

   "source": [
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "\n",
    "from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, RandomizedSearchCV\n",
    "from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder\n",
    "from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer\n",
    "from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline\n",
    "from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor\n",
    "from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, classification_report, confusion_matrix\n",
    "from scipy.stats import randint\n",
    "\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "# 1. Prepare data\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "df_rf = pd.read_csv(\"global_ai_jobs.csv\")\n",
    "\n",
    "drop_cols = ['bonus_usd', 'salary_percentile', 'id']\n",
    "df_rf = df_rf.drop(columns=[c for c in drop_cols if c in df_rf.columns])\n",
    "df_rf = df_rf.dropna()\n",
    "\n",
    "NUM_BINS = 3\n",
    "\n",
    "df_rf['salary_bin_5'], bin_edges = pd.qcut(\n",
    "    df_rf['salary_usd'],\n",
    "    q=NUM_BINS,\n",
    "    labels=False,\n",
    "    retbins=True,\n",
    "    duplicates='drop'\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "df_rf['salary_bin_5'] = df_rf['salary_bin_5'].astype(int)\n",
    "\n",
    "X = df_rf.drop(columns=['salary_usd', 'salary_bin_5'])\n",
    "y_salary = df_rf['salary_usd']\n",
    "y_bin = df_rf['salary_bin_5']\n",
    "\n",
    "cat_cols = X.select_dtypes(exclude=np.number).columns.tolist()\n",
    "num_cols = X.select_dtypes(include=np.number).columns.tolist()\n",
    "\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "# 2. Split\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "X_train, X_test, y_salary_train, y_salary_test, y_bin_train, y_bin_test = train_test_split(\n",
    "    X,\n",
    "    y_salary,\n",
    "    y_bin,\n",
    "    test_size=0.30,\n",
    "    random_state=42,\n",
    "    stratify=y_bin\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "# 3. Preprocess\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "preprocess = ColumnTransformer([\n",
    "    ('cat', OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore'), cat_cols),\n",
    "    ('num', 'passthrough', num_cols)\n",
    "])\n",
    "\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "# 4. Random Forest Regressor\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "rf_reg = Pipeline([\n",
    "    ('preprocess', preprocess),\n",
    "    ('regressor', RandomForestRegressor(\n",
    "        n_estimators=300,\n",
    "        max_depth=None,\n",
    "        min_samples_split=4,\n",
    "        min_samples_leaf=2,\n",
    "        max_features='sqrt',\n",
    "        bootstrap=True,\n",
    "        random_state=42,\n",
    "        n_jobs=-1\n",
    "    ))\n",
    "])\n",
    "\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "# 5. Train\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "rf_reg.fit(X_train, y_salary_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "# 6. Predict salary → convert to bins\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "pred_salary = rf_reg.predict(X_test)\n",
    "\n",
    "pred_bins = np.digitize(pred_salary, bin_edges[1:-1], right=True)\n",
    "pred_bins = np.clip(pred_bins, 0, NUM_BINS - 1)\n",
    "\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "# 7. Evaluate\n",
    "# =========================\n",
    "print(\"Random Forest Regression → Bin Accuracy:\", accuracy_score(y_bin_test, pred_bins))\n",

    "print(classification_report(y_bin_test, pred_bins))\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\nConfusion Matrix:\")\n",

    "print(\"Within 1 bin accuracy:\", np.mean(errors <= 1))\n",
